operations.name: activate
operations.help: Activate the candidate CLI definition, or import a named definition or interface export.

operations.name: enter
operations.help: Enter an interface context by identity; / selects root and .. selects parent.

operations.name: discover
operations.help: Inspect active context, related contexts, commands, simulation state, and last mock outcome.

operations.name: invoke
operations.help: Invoke a configured local command with declared scalar arguments; success records a simulation-only receipt.

operations.name: export-interface
operations.help: Create a portable export retaining active definition, simulated state, and labeled outcomes.
